about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting a Leasing Administration Officer to support a well-established organisation in Malta's automotive industry, based in Gżira. You will help oversee and manage the daily administrative requirements of the vehicle leasing function.

The work covers the full life of a leased vehicle: documentation, insurance and road licensing for new vehicles, insurance renewals, CVA payments, VRT testing, citations and penalty points, supplier invoicing with the Finance Department, and closing and archiving files for sold vehicles.

You will support the Operations Executive and Sales Manager and welcome visitors at reception. The role suits an organised, customer-oriented person with strong Maltese and English. It is full-time and on-site, with a competitive salary.
responsibilities: Provide day-to-day support to the Operations Executive and Sales Manager
Supervise, administer and monitor daily workflow within the Leasing Administration function
Process documentation for new vehicles, including insurance and licensing
Liaise with insurance providers on renewals and process road licence renewals
Coordinate with the Finance Department on invoicing for services such as car washes, pest control, stationery, water, cleaning and fuel
Assign new vehicles to the appropriate car wash centre
Process CVA payments and issue invoices to clients
Identify vehicles requiring VRT testing and pass the information to the responsible contact
Manage citation payments, petitions, point transfers and client invoicing
Make sure penalty points from fleet vehicles are not incorrectly attributed to company directors
Welcome visitors at reception and direct them to the right staff member
Close and archive files for sold vehicles and arrange insurance credit notes
Open files for new vehicles, both replacements and new leases, assign drivers and keep filing in order
Attend training required by the company and follow all company policies and procedures
requirements: Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications
Strong verbal and written communication skills in both Maltese and English
A high standard of work and service at all times
